sentence: This project tries to find out how a soft robotic fish can use its own soft body to control its swimming.
This project builds a type of memory from vertical transistors that uses less energy in chips for AI.
This project builds digital maps of indoor spaces to help people, including those with disabilities, navigate them.
This project designs ways for graphics processing units to work on large meshes much faster.
This project builds a method to compare how humans and AI tools make decisions, using lung cancer diagnoses by radiologists as a test case.
This project studies whether tropical forests in the Amazon can recover after fires, droughts and windstorms.
This project tries to find out how cruciviruses evolved, using environmental samples.
This project builds a sensor that tells whether single virus shells are fully loaded, partially loaded, or empty of therapeutic DNA.
This project seeks to discover and describe spiders inhabiting soil in California, using fieldwork and genomics.
This project studies how mountain hummingbirds vary in genetic, behavioral and physiological responses to temperature and oxygen scarcity.
This project combines experiments with computational analyses to discover how diseases work and to identify treatments.
This project studies how atomic-scale defects in ultra-thin semiconductors give off single photons.
This project designs a chip and methods that let small robots work out where they are and map obstacles using little energy.
This project studies how cyberattacks affect transportation infrastructure and recommends defense solutions.
This project studies how electron waves behave near a wall and how electrons close together act, aiming to improve electron microscopes.
This project studies how the structure of forest canopies shapes the climate that organisms experience.
